item.title: Conservatives unveil plans for £36bn of benefit cuts
item.body: The Conservative leader has launched a Welfare That Works policy document outlining planned benefit reductions of £36bn. Labour has described the proposals as "a charter for human misery".

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 💷 Conservatives unveil plans for £36bn of benefit cuts

The Conservative leader has launched a Welfare That Works policy document outlining planned benefit reductions of £36bn. Labour has described the proposals as "a charter for human misery".

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
